questions.q: What is the approximate percentage of carbon dioxide in expired air?
questions.why: Expired air has about 4 % CO₂; 0.04 % is inspired air and 16 % is oxygen in expired air.

questions.q: Which is the word equation for anaerobic respiration in muscles?
questions.why: Anaerobic respiration in muscles makes lactic acid only, with no oxygen used and no CO₂.

questions.q: Why do breathing rate and depth increase during exercise?
options: Low oxygen in the blood is detected by the lungs.
The heart detects more lactic acid.
The muscles need more carbon dioxide.
Higher carbon dioxide concentration in the blood is detected by the brain.
questions.why: The syllabus explanation: increased blood CO₂ concentration is detected by the brain.

questions.q: After a sprint, a runner keeps breathing faster and deeper for several minutes. Explain why.
questions.model: To supply oxygen for the aerobic respiration of lactic acid in the liver, removing the oxygen debt.
points: in the liver / repays oxygen debt
